title: Newly Uploaded Videos Fail Playback
description: Starting around 18:05 UTC on 16 August 2026, users reported that newly uploaded videos on StreamForge frequently fail to play and return HTTP 503 responses. Existing videos that were successfully transcoded before 18:05 UTC continue to play normally. Video uploads succeed at the upload layer, but transcoding jobs fail downstream, leaving playback manifests unavailable.

evidence.content: upload-service metrics (17:50 - 18:15 UTC): Success rate: 99.98%, p95 latency: 410ms, active upload streams: 240/300. No meaningful upload errors detected. Upload service is operating normally.

video-transcoding-service node disk utilization (17:50 - 18:15 UTC): Baseline disk utilization: 45-60%. Node-4 disk: 96%, Node-7 disk: 98%, Node-9 disk: 97%. Storage threshold crossed 90% around 18:05-18:06 UTC. Transcoding job write failures increased immediately after threshold was crossed.

Deployment Event: video-transcoding-service release v4.2.0 deployed at 17:58 UTC. Configuration changes: temporary workspace size allocated per node reduced from 50Gi to 8Gi. Retry policy updated so temporary FFmpeg working files are retained during retry attempts instead of purged.

Transcoding Service Operations Runbook:
1. Transcoder disk utilization above 90% requires immediate investigation.
2. ENOSPC error indicates FFmpeg temporary working directory space is exhausted.
3. Failed transcoding jobs leave playback artifacts ungenerated, causing downstream manifest_not_found errors.
4. Emergency Mitigation: Roll back recent transcoding deployment and clean orphaned temporary workspace directories.
Historical Incident INC-2911 (Resolved): Transcoder temporary workspace exhaustion caused by unpurged temp files. Resolved by rolling back deployment and purging /tmp/ffmpeg_workspace.
